svg.title: Okta assignment, token issuance, and app membership are separate gates
svg.desc: App assignment admits a user to the Okta client, and the custom authorization-server policy permits token issuance. The example requires the exact app-members value in the ID-token groups claim. A claim released only through UserInfo does not satisfy this named-driver walkthrough. Test an assigned nonmember to isolate AuthCrunch denial.
